title: doctor accepts a project with no skill copy and says what a launch carries
source: intended: a session that jitso launches runs with --setting-sources project, so the user copy never reaches it; the launch package carries the jitso skill instead
intent: The user copy of the skill serves the owner's own interactive session. A launched worker reads project skills from the checkout, and the jitso skill travels in the launch package for a conductor build or a build that names jitso, so a project with no copy is `ok`, not `warn`, and the line says what a launch carries.

stdout.regex: (?m)^ok   skill-project: not installed \(optional: a launch carries the jitso skill for a conductor build or a build that names jitso; run jitso install skill --scope project to keep a copy in the checkout\)$
